panels.title: Constraint Eff. All-Time (arc target ≥80%; see JIMINY-CEILING-BREAK-2)
panels.description: ⚠️ TRAJECTORY: current value is arc-in-progress; target is ≥80%. JIMINY-CEILING-BREAK-2 shipped Phases 1-4a + arc-adjacent corpus purges 2026-08-11/12 (constraints 33/33 tombstoned, corrections 35/39 tombstoned, scope-gate at surface + mechanism-scope gate at classify + informational category). Post-2026-08-19 passive re-check expected ~30-40%; Phase 4b classifier retrain + Phase 5 model swap close the remaining gap. Do NOT normalize the current value as 'by design' — see docs/development/jiminy-ceiling-break-2/. HISTORICAL CONTEXT ↓: Volume-weighted effectiveness across constraints with 5+ outcomes (all time). DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E7 (2026-07-20): reads TSDB constraint_outcomes directly (was reading Neo4j gauge which cumulated pre-2026-06-11 heuristic half-credit inflation → All-Time and Selected Range diverged by up to 0.10 for the same underlying data). Now both panels share source-of-truth AND filter classifier_source IN ('llm','tier1','explicit') to exclude the ~50%25 heuristic-labeled rows. HAVING >= 5 preserves the historical All-Time threshold; Selected Range uses HAVING >= 2 for smaller windows.

targets.rawSql:
-- DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E7: unified source-of-truth (was reading pre-fix-inflated Neo4j gauge).
WITH per_constraint AS (
  SELECT constraint_id,
         COUNT(*) AS surfaced,
         SUM(CASE WHEN outcome_type = 'followed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS followed,
         SUM(CASE WHEN outcome_type = 'partial_compliance' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END) AS partial_half
  FROM constraint_outcomes
  WHERE space_id = '$space_id'
    AND classifier_source IN ('llm', 'tier1', 'explicit')
  GROUP BY constraint_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT now() AS time,
       CASE WHEN SUM(surfaced) > 0
            THEN (SUM(followed) + SUM(partial_half)) / SUM(surfaced)::float
            ELSE NULL
       END AS value
FROM per_constraint

panels.title: Actionable Compliance Rate (arc target ≥80%; see JIMINY-CEILING-BREAK-2)
panels.description: ⚠️ TRAJECTORY: current value is arc-in-progress; target is ≥80%. JIMINY-CEILING-BREAK-2 shipped Phases 1-4a + arc-adjacent corpus purges 2026-08-11/12 (constraints 33/33 tombstoned, corrections 35/39 tombstoned, scope-gate at surface + mechanism-scope gate at classify + informational category). Post-2026-08-19 passive re-check expected ~30-40%; Phase 4b classifier retrain + Phase 5 model swap close the remaining gap. Do NOT normalize the current value as 'by design' — see docs/development/jiminy-ceiling-break-2/. HISTORICAL CONTEXT ↓: Compliance rate on ACTIONABLE guidance types (constraint/correction), excluding correctly-ignored advisory abstractions (pattern/learning/concept). JIMINY-ACTIONABILITY-INVERSION-001 discovered this rate reads LOWER than raw follow rate (10% vs 15%) under current architecture — an emergent effect of (constraint semantics × Lever C over-surfacing × correct must/should classifier calibration), NOT a defect. The >90% goal ISN'T the right frame — real actionable rate under Lever C's aggressive constraint-partition biasing has an expected floor around 10-25%. WATCH THE TREND OVER 14-DAY WINDOWS, not the absolute value. See ab_verdict.md at docs/development/jiminy-actionability-compliance-credit-001/ab_verdict.md for the reference measurement (12.97% burst-adjusted steady state, KEEP-ON verdict). DASHBOARD-TRUTH-001: not_applicable / blank / unknown excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator. Matches the guidance_should_follow_rate_low alert. Computed from guidance_training_rows in the dashboard time range (followed=1.0, partial_compliance=0.5). DASHBOARD-TRUTH-003 (2026-08-01) recalibrated bands per the JIMINY-ACTIONABILITY-INVERSION observation: red<0.05 = alert floor (guidance_should_follow_rate_low); yellow 0.05-0.10 = below-expected; green-neutral 0.10-0.25 = the expected by-design steady-state band (this is where healthy substrate lives, NOT green); green≥0.25 = above the honest ceiling (corpus-quality lift is working).

panels.title: Auto-compact AVG interval (LONGER=BETTER)
panels.description: Average interval between Claude auto-compact events (pre-compact hook → compact_event_ts). Computed over DISTINCT event timestamps of the LAST 10 events regardless of dashboard window — compactions are rare (days apart), so a windowed query read 'no value' on any range narrower than ~2 events, and the gauge's repeated flush rows previously inflated COUNT(*) (interval understated). LONGER is BETTER: frequent compaction means context pressure. DASHBOARD-TRUTH-003 (2026-08-01): copy-fix from the j17 twin panel that DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 already fixed 2026-07-21.

targets.rawSql:
-- distinct compact events, last 10 lifetime (rare-event stream; no window filter)
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT value FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_name = 'mdemg_compact_event_ts' AND metric_type = 'gauge'
    AND space_id = '$space_id' AND value > 0
  ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT (MAX(value) - MIN(value)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) - 1, 0) / 60.0 AS value FROM ev

targets.cypherQuery: MATCH (c:MemoryNode {space_id: '$space_id', role_type: 'constraint'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[r:GUIDANCE_OUTCOME]-() WITH c.content AS Constraint, count(r) AS Surfaced, count(CASE WHEN r.outcome_type = 'followed' THEN 1 END) AS Followed, count(CASE WHEN r.outcome_type = 'partial_compliance' THEN 1 END) AS Partial, count(CASE WHEN r.outcome_type = 'ignored' THEN 1 END) AS Ignored, count(CASE WHEN r.outcome_type = 'contradicted' THEN 1 END) AS Contradicted WHERE Surfaced > 0 RETURN Constraint, Surfaced, Followed, Partial, Ignored, Contradicted, round((toFloat(Followed) + 0.5 * toFloat(Partial)) / Surfaced * 100) / 100 AS EffRate ORDER BY Surfaced DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Actionable Follow Rate — Arc Trajectory (baseline 13.25% → target ≥80%)
panels.description: ARC-TRAJECTORY-PANEL-001 (2026-08-12): live trajectory of the JIMINY-CEILING-BREAK-2 arc. Blue = actionable follow rate over the dashboard time range (1h buckets over constraint_outcomes filtered to guidance_type IN ('constraint','correction'), followed=1.0 + partial=0.5). Orange dashed = baseline (13.25%) at arc-shipping-complete moment (2026-08-12 18:17 UTC, captured in commit a142fca3). Threshold line at 80% is the arc target — do NOT normalize any current-value framing as 'by design'; the arc actively lifts this. Passive re-check windows: T+72h 2026-08-15, T+168h 2026-08-19. See docs/development/jiminy-ceiling-break-2/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time,   ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE outcome_type WHEN 'followed' THEN 1.0                           WHEN 'partial_compliance' THEN 0.5                           ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))::numeric, 2)   AS "Actionable Follow Rate (%)" FROM constraint_outcomes WHERE space_id = '$space_id'   AND guidance_type IN ('constraint','correction')   AND outcome_type IN ('followed','partial_compliance','ignored','contradicted')   AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time,   13.25 AS "Baseline (2026-08-12 18:17 UTC)" FROM constraint_outcomes WHERE space_id = '$space_id'   AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
